prompts.prompt: Create ONE production sprite sheet for a single HANI OS office character. Reference image 1 is this character's identity (hair, clothing, accessories); reference image 2 is ONLY the established office chibi STYLE. Match the style's polished hand-drawn anime chibi: very large rounded head ~50% total height, tiny body, warm brown outlines, gentle cel shading, expressive large eyes, clean readable silhouette. Not pixel art, not 3D, not realistic. A square 1024x1024 transparent canvas, EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body sprites in a strict equal 2x2 grid. Each quadrant is 512x512. Upper-left FRONT STANDING, upper-right FRONT SITTING on an invisible chair (bent knees, hands forward, shorter overall height, no chair or desk drawn), lower-left WALK STEP A right foot forward left arm forward, lower-right WALK STEP B left foot forward right arm forward. All face forward with slight three-quarter walking stance, same identity, same head size and body proportions, entire body visible within each quadrant. Put each character foot baseline 40 px above its quadrant bottom, head within quadrant, ample transparent gutters. Subtle small soft translucent neutral floor shadow beneath feet in each quadrant. No text, letters, labels, logos, watermark, border, grid lines, props outside requested character. True alpha transparency, no painted checkerboard. Output should permit clean quadrant cropping and resizing to 48x64 cells. Character identity: HANI 하니, long flowing dark brown hair, deep plum blazer and matching skirt, white blouse, small gold earrings, calm warm smile. Preserve the older office sprite identity exactly.
